content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in both windows, visible error events appear within about 60 to 200 ms of the first input into the \"As Of Date\" field (S65766c5e: input 9155 ms, errors 9212 and 9357 ms; S39f93c58: input 9852 ms, errors 9908 and 10065 ms), before the user moves on to Entity and Portfolio, so validation feedback on the date field may be interrupting the form.", "fix": "Fix: On the cashflow report form, make the \"As Of Date\" validation message render inline beside that field and run validation on blur or submit instead of on each keystroke, so the first typed value does not raise a visible error before the Portfolio field is reached.", "cited_event_ids": ["115", "117:a139", "121:a144", "113", "115:a142", "119:a147"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The error events have no label or field name, so it is not confirmed that they belong to the As Of Date field.", "The windows do not show the user leaving the form without saving: in both sessions the Portfolio input is followed by a click on Run (171 at 11164 ms; 170 at 12940 ms), which conflicts with the stated abandonment outcome.", "Nothing in the windows links the Portfolio field itself to an error or to abandonment.", "The windows cover only about 30 s, so the roughly 11 s median loss per affected user cannot be checked against the full session.", "The event ids 113 and 115 are reused across sessions with different meanings, so the citations are only unambiguous with the session prefix.", "Coverage is empty, so overlay timing is not used as evidence."]}
